adaptability.e: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.

aftermath.e: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.

analytic.e: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

anger-point.e: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

anger-shell.e: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

anticipation.e: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

arena-trap.e: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing from battle.

armor-tail.e: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

aroma-veil.e: Protects the Pokémon and its allies from effects that prevent the use of moves.

battery.e: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.

battle-armor.e: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

battle-bond.e: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, its bond with its Trainer is strengthened, and its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted.

beads-of-ruin.e: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

big-pecks.e: Prevents the Pokémon from having its Defense stat lowered.

blaze.e: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

bulletproof.e: Protects the Pokémon from ball and bomb moves.

cheek-pouch.e: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.

chlorophyll.e: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

clear-body.e: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

comatose.e: The Pokémon is always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack while in its sleeping state.

commander.e: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

competitive.e: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

compound-eyes.e: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

contrary.e: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them—and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

corrosion.e: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.

costar.e: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

cud-chew.e: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

curious-medicine.e: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

cursed-body.e: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.

cute-charm.e: The Pokémon may infatuate attackers that make direct contact with it.

damp.e: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.

dancer.e: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.

dazzling.e: The Pokémon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

defiant.e: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.

disguise.e: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

download.e: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.

drizzle.e: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

drought.e: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

dry-skin.e: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

early-bird.e: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

earth-eater.e: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

effect-spore.e: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on the attacker.

electric-surge.e: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

electromorphosis.e: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

filter.e: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

flame-body.e: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

flare-boost.e: Powers up special moves when the Pokémon is burned.

flash-fire.e: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

flower-veil.e: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.

fluffy.e: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

forewarn.e: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

frisk.e: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

fur-coat.e: Halves the damage from physical moves.

gale-wings.e: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.

galvanize.e: This Pokémon's Normal moves are Electric and have their power increased to 1.2×.

gluttony.e: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.

good-as-gold.e: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

gooey.e: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

grass-pelt.e: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.

grassy-surge.e: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

guard-dog.e: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

gulp-missile.e: If a Cramorant with Gulp Missile uses Surf or Dive, it catches prey and changes its form depending on its remaining HP.

guts.e: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

hadron-engine.e: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

harvest.e: May create another Berry after one is used.

healer.e: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.

heatproof.e: The Pokémon's heatproof body halves the damage taken from Fire-type moves.

honey-gather.e: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.

hospitality.e: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.

hunger-switch.e: Causes Morpeko to change its form each turn, alternating between Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode

hustle.e: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.

hydration.e: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.

hyper-cutter.e: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

ice-body.e: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

ice-face.e: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

ice-scales.e: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

illusion.e: The Pokémon fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its Trainer's party.

immunity.e: The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.

imposter.e: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.

infiltrator.e: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.

inner-focus.e: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

intimidate.e: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

justified.e: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

keen-eye.e: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

klutz.e: The Pokémon can't use any held items.

leaf-guard.e: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.

levitate.e: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

libero.e: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

lightning-rod.e: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

limber.e: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

lingering-aroma.e: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

liquid-ooze.e: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.

long-reach.e: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

magic-bounce.e: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.

magic-guard.e: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

magician.e: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

magma-armor.e: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.

magnet-pull.e: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

marvel-scale.e: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.

merciless.e: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

minds-eye.e: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

minus.e: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

mirror-armor.e: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

misty-surge.e: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

mold-breaker.e: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

moody.e: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.

motor-drive.e: Absorbs Electric moves, raising Speed one stage.

moxie.e: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

multiscale.e: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

mycelium-might.e: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

natural-cure.e: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.

neutralizing-gas.e: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.

no-guard.e: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.

oblivious.e: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

opportunist.e: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

orichalcum-pulse.e: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

overcoat.e: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.

overgrow.e: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

own-tempo.e: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

pickpocket.e: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.

pickup.e: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

pixilate.e: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

plus.e: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

poison-heal.e: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

poison-point.e: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

poison-puppeteer.e: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

poison-touch.e: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.

power-of-alchemy.e: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

power-spot.e: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

prankster.e: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.

pressure.e: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

propeller-tail.e: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

protean.e: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

protosynthesis.e: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

psychic-surge.e: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

punk-rock.e: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

pure-power.e: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

purifying-salt.e: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

quark-drive.e: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

queenly-majesty.e: The Pokémon's majesty pressures opponents and makes them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

quick-draw.e: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

quick-feet.e: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.

rain-dish.e: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

rattled.e: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

receiver.e: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

reckless.e: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

regenerator.e: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.

ripen.e: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

rivalry.e: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

rock-head.e: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

rough-skin.e: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.

run-away.e: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

sand-force.e: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

sand-rush.e: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

sand-spit.e: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

sand-stream.e: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

sand-veil.e: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

sap-sipper.e: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.

scrappy.e: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

seed-sower.e: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

serene-grace.e: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.

shadow-tag.e: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

shed-skin.e: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

sheer-force.e: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

shell-armor.e: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

shield-dust.e: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

shields-down.e: Transforms this Minior between Core Form and Meteor Form. Prevents major status ailments and drowsiness while in Meteor Form.

simple.e: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon's stat changes.

skill-link.e: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

slow-start.e: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.

slush-rush.e: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.

sniper.e: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.

snow-cloak.e: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.

snow-warning.e: The Pokémon makes it snow when it enters a battle.

solar-power.e: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

solid-rock.e: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

soundproof.e: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

speed-boost.e: The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.

stakeout.e: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.

stall.e: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.

stalwart.e: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

stamina.e: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

static.e: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

steadfast.e: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.

steam-engine.e: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

stench.e: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

sticky-hold.e: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

storm-drain.e: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

strong-jaw.e: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

sturdy.e: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

suction-cups.e: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.

super-luck.e: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

supersweet-syrup.e: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.

supreme-overlord.e: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

surge-surfer.e: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

swarm.e: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

sweet-veil.e: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.

swift-swim.e: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

sword-of-ruin.e: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

symbiosis.e: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.

synchronize.e: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

tablets-of-ruin.e: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

tangled-feet.e: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.

tangling-hair.e: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

technician.e: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.

telepathy.e: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

tera-shell.e: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

tera-shift.e: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.

teraform-zero.e: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.

thermal-exchange.e: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

thick-fat.e: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

tinted-lens.e: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.

torrent.e: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

tough-claws.e: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

toxic-boost.e: Powers up physical moves when the Pokémon is poisoned.

toxic-chain.e: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.

toxic-debris.e: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

trace.e: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

triage.e: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

truant.e: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.

unaware.e: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.

unburden.e: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

unnerve.e: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

vessel-of-ruin.e: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

vital-spirit.e: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

volt-absorb.e: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

water-absorb.e: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

water-bubble.e: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.

water-compaction.e: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.

water-veil.e: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.

weak-armor.e: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.

well-baked-body.e: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

white-smoke.e: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

wind-power.e: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

wind-rider.e: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

wonder-skin.e: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.

zero-to-hero.e: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
